1.

Precious name, that name Jesus! God’s, the Most High’s, Son, Thou for us in love didst leave Heaven’s throne.

2.

Jesus, name that for us speaks Of Thy lowliness here. Thou, who above all kings, Art King.

3.

Jesus! Thou, who to us didst say On Thy desert path: “I am meek, of heart lowly, Learn of Me!”

4.

Thou art He who for us didst suffer Distress and poverty, And on the cross’s tree hast borne All our judgment.

5.

Jesus! Thou for us didst let flow Here Thy precious blood, Which now proclaims to all: God is good.

6.

Jesus, name in glory Above all exalted, Name by angels highly admired, Heaven’s joy!
